description: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) entries from US Treasury, refreshed daily, republished as-is (not a screening service; verify against treasury.gov). One row per sanctioned person, entity, vessel or aircraft, under one or more programs. US persons are prohibited from transacting with SDNs. No designation date (OFAC's SDN.csv omits it). More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_ofac_sdn

name.description: Substring of the primary name or any OFAC alias (a.k.a., f.k.a., n.k.a.).

remarks.description: Substring of OFAC's Remarks: DOB, passports. Not aliases (name searches those).

name: get_ofac_sdn
